inspiration.observed_pattern: SHOW COLUMNS exposes typed schema metadata, including BLOB result columns for the Type and Default fields and unquoted string defaults.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one primary-key integer and one defaulted required VARCHAR so SHOW COLUMNS metadata and default rendering are isolated from the original dispatch schema.

fixture_notes: The schema has one primary key and one required defaulted VARCHAR. MariaDB reports Type and Default as BLOB metadata and returns the default without SQL quotes.
determinism_notes: DDL and column order are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
